event.name: beat_loyalists
event.text: VASILE: This isn't a crackdown - it's a collapse. Stay off the boulevard.

event.name: beat_volkov
event.text: INTERCEPT: North border logged one vehicle at first light. Volkov ran.

event.name: beat_retardovici
event.text: PA: Citizens. Curfew holds. The Presidency has this under control.
